title: Hearty Dutch Stew
description: A warm and comforting Dutch stew made with tender chunks of beef and fresh vegetables.

ingredients.name: Dutch Tomato Paste
ingredients.notes: Dissolved in 2 cups of beef broth

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add carrot and potato and cook for 5 minutes.
Add beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Return beef to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
